dct_title_s: Ethiopia: IRC Ethiopia Sub Grantee Projects by Sectors and Donors
dct_description_sm: IRC indirectly implemented Projects through sub grants awarded to 9 implementing partners, which are intervened in the different part of Ethiopia and in a refugee camp (Bokolmayo). The data shows the interventions for the period of June 2024 by detail activities, Sectors, Donors and implementing partners. The programs are emergency responses, IDPs, local community development programs and refugee portfolios. Out of the implementing partners OSHID has got the highest coverage of the project (54.9%) followed by CVDA and FSA; 14.1% & 12.7%, respectively. Looking to project activities there are 5 sector of interventions, whereby Health sector has got the highest (89.3.%), while the rest 4 sectors have each below 5%. From donors perspective, 4 donors granted the sub grantee projects, while GAVI BHA has got the highest (88.4%) and similarly the rest each has got below 5%. IRC’s GIS team created this database to allow for a more sustained approach to producing relevant mapping products and geospatial analysis for undergoing humanitarian responses and will fill gaps in information sharing and management between Donors. IRC’s GIS services provides information and analysis required to monitor the evolution of project / program results and to track project and program impacts across geographic locations. This dataset contains boundaries of Ethiopian administrative Woredas which are roughly consistent with the actual & updated administrative boundaries which bases CSA 2007 Census survey out puts. The Woreda boundary contains attribute data (, activities, Sector Donors Fields) for IRC Ethiopia for IRC Direct Projects- June 2024
